title_en: December 21, by the road, 2 apartments for sale 1+1, 3rd floor, new residential building with elevator.
description_en: December 21, by the road, 2 apartments for sale 1+1, 3rd floor, new residential building with elevator. WITH MORTGAGE. Gross area 55 m2 and 53 m2. 7-storey building, 3 entrances per floor. Entrance from the main road. Staircase with natural light. Dressed with capot system. Totally reconstructed, new doors and windows, new hydraulic and electrical system, suspended ceilings, laid with parquet, tiled, etc.... Ready for habitation. Very suitable for business activities. With south-west orientation. A good opportunity, both for residence and for investment. In the process of construction. Sold empty. Price for AP 55 m2 158,000 euros. Price for AP 53 m2 155,000 euros. Negotiable.
